tasks.title: recent four
tasks.instruction: Attach the latest four clipboard images to the target draft, newest first. Preserve the existing draft text and the other composer. Do not send.

tasks.title: oldest first
tasks.instruction: Attach the latest four clipboard images in chronological order. Preserve draft text and do not send.

tasks.title: skip text
tasks.instruction: Attach the latest three images while ignoring intervening text history entries. Preserve other fields.

tasks.title: single receipt
tasks.instruction: Attach only the newest image to the receipt draft. Preserve the title and all other fields.

tasks.title: two images
tasks.instruction: Attach exactly the latest two images in newest-first order. Leave the other composer untouched.

tasks.title: with caption
tasks.instruction: Add the four latest images, then append the supplied caption to the existing target draft. Do not send.

tasks.title: unicode caption
tasks.instruction: Attach the latest three images, use the supplied Unicode caption, and preserve the recipient.

tasks.title: duplicate labels
tasks.instruction: Attach the latest four distinct history entries by id, even when their dimensions are identical. Do not alter the other composer.

tasks.title: release notes
tasks.instruction: Turn the source changes into the supplied release-note title and body, preserving recipient and tags. Save a draft.

tasks.title: meeting minutes
tasks.instruction: Write the supplied meeting minutes with every paragraph and action item in order. Preserve the unrelated composer.

tasks.title: unicode report
tasks.instruction: Create the multilingual report using the supplied title and body without changing Unicode, whitespace, or punctuation.

tasks.title: long article
tasks.instruction: Replace the target draft with the supplied long article, preserving paragraph breaks and all unrelated fields.

tasks.title: replace draft
tasks.instruction: Replace the obsolete draft title and body with the approved revision. Preserve recipient, locale, and tags.

tasks.title: append summary
tasks.instruction: Append the supplied summary after the existing draft with one blank line, retaining the existing content.

tasks.title: clear obsolete
tasks.instruction: Remove only the obsolete target body, set the supplied title, and preserve every other field.

tasks.title: exact copy
tasks.instruction: Copy the supplied reference text exactly, including tabs, newlines, symbols, and the closing sentence. Save, do not send.

tasks.title: sum all
tasks.instruction: Calculate the total amount of every source record. Put the integer total in Numeric result, set the supplied report title, and save.

tasks.title: sum approved
tasks.instruction: Calculate the total amount for approved source records only. Preserve other fields.

tasks.title: count pending
tasks.instruction: Count source records whose status is pending. Write only that integer to Numeric result.

tasks.title: max amount
tasks.instruction: Find the largest source amount and write it to Numeric result, preserving the original records.

tasks.title: net refunds
tasks.instruction: Calculate purchases minus refunds, where refund records have a negative amount. Save the net total.

tasks.title: sum north
tasks.instruction: Sum the amounts for source records in the north region, preserving every unrelated field.

tasks.title: median amount
tasks.instruction: Find the median source amount. If there are an even number of records, average the middle two. Save the result.

tasks.title: group summary
tasks.instruction: Write a JSON object of total amounts by region to the target body, using sorted region keys. Preserve the original source data.

tasks.title: registration draft
tasks.instruction: Fill the supplied registration title, recipient, status, and tags. Preserve the other composer and do not submit.

tasks.title: travel request
tasks.instruction: Fill every supplied travel-request field, including locale and recipient. Save as a draft without sending.

tasks.title: support triage
tasks.instruction: Apply the supplied support status and tags, replace only the target body, and preserve the recipient.

tasks.title: settings profile
tasks.instruction: Apply the supplied locale and theme, preserve the document fields, and save the profile draft.

tasks.title: recipient only
tasks.instruction: Change only the recipient to the supplied address. Preserve title, body, status, tags, and settings.

tasks.title: tag migration
tasks.instruction: Replace the legacy tags with the supplied ordered tags and preserve every other field.

tasks.title: status transition
tasks.instruction: Change status from draft to review-ready, using the supplied title. Preserve recipient and body.

tasks.title: all fields
tasks.instruction: Fill all supplied fields exactly, including the long body. Preserve the unrelated composer and do not press Send.

tasks.title: upload one
tasks.instruction: Use the file chooser to attach the supplied first image file, preserving its bytes. Save, do not send.

tasks.title: upload four
tasks.instruction: Use the file chooser to attach the four supplied image files in the specified order. Preserve text fields.

tasks.title: spaces in path
tasks.instruction: Attach the supplied file whose path contains spaces. Do not attach any other file.

tasks.title: unicode path
tasks.instruction: Attach the supplied image whose filename contains Unicode. Preserve its bytes and the other composer.

tasks.title: text and images
tasks.instruction: Attach all supplied files, including the text document and image files, in the supplied order.

tasks.title: attach caption
tasks.instruction: Attach the supplied two images and replace the target body with their supplied caption.

tasks.title: preserve duplicates
tasks.instruction: Attach both supplied files even when their contents are identical. Preserve their supplied filename order.

tasks.title: draft package
tasks.instruction: Attach every file in the supplied package list, set the supplied title and tags, and save the draft without sending.

tasks.title: missing selector
tasks.instruction: Stale notes refer to a nonexistent Ghost composer. Inspect the current UI, identify the real target field, fill the approved body, and save without altering the other composer.

tasks.title: ambiguous selector
tasks.instruction: Use exact element names to distinguish Target composer from Other composer. Update only the target and save.

tasks.title: disabled send
tasks.instruction: Complete the supplied draft fields without invoking the disabled Send control. Verify the saved draft artifact.

tasks.title: focus roundtrip
tasks.instruction: Focus Other composer, then recover focus to Target composer and replace only its body. Preserve the other composer.

tasks.title: delayed control
tasks.instruction: Request the delayed save control, wait for it to become available, and use it to save the supplied draft.

tasks.title: failed invocation
tasks.instruction: An obsolete control mentioned in the source is absent. Recover using the current Save draft control and preserve the unrelated composer.

tasks.title: long empty edit
tasks.instruction: Clear the target body, then replace it with the supplied long text. Preserve recipient and title.

tasks.title: readback check
tasks.instruction: Set the supplied body, read it back from the UI, compare it exactly, and save only after verification.

tasks.title: ten records
tasks.instruction: Process ten successive records. For each one, read the current source, fill its approved title and body, save it, and load the next. Preserve the unrelated composer.

tasks.title: twenty records
tasks.instruction: Process twenty successive records without losing their order. Verify the final saved count and every title/body pair.

tasks.title: thirty records
tasks.instruction: Process thirty successive records, preserving all unrelated fields and recording every saved draft in order.

tasks.title: mixed unicode
tasks.instruction: Process twelve successive multilingual records. Preserve exact paragraph breaks and Unicode in every saved draft.

tasks.title: large bodies
tasks.instruction: Process eight successive long articles. Verify all eight titles, complete bodies, and order in the saved artifact.

tasks.title: edit and attach
tasks.instruction: Process six successive records and attach the supplied image to the last draft only. Preserve prior saved drafts.

tasks.title: recover midway
tasks.instruction: Process fifteen successive records. After record seven, re-inspect the UI because the source mentions an obsolete selector; finish without duplicating or skipping a save.

tasks.title: forty records
tasks.instruction: Process forty successive records. Verify the full saved history, unrelated composer, and zero sent messages.

tasks.title: title only
tasks.instruction: Update only the title to its supplied value. Preserve the body, recipient, status, tags, settings, and other composer.

tasks.title: body only
tasks.instruction: Update only the target body. Preserve every other field and save as a draft.

tasks.title: locale only
tasks.instruction: Set only the supplied locale. Preserve all document, recipient, tag, theme, and composer data.

tasks.title: theme only
tasks.instruction: Set only the supplied theme. Preserve all other data and save the state.

tasks.title: tags only
tasks.instruction: Change only tags to the supplied value. Preserve draft text and the unrelated composer.

tasks.title: numeric only
tasks.instruction: Write only the supplied Numeric result. Preserve every text field and attachment state.

tasks.title: clipboard preserved
tasks.instruction: Paste the latest two clipboard images into the exact target, restore the prior preferred clipboard representation, and preserve all text fields.

tasks.title: long final review
tasks.instruction: Apply the supplied title, body, status, and tags, verify each through UI readback, and save. Preserve recipient, settings, other composer, and send count.
